history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that the accountability structure and coordination mechanism under the United Nations Sustainable Development Group is fully functional with regard to implementation of the development reform initiatives.
history.administration_response: As the United Nations Sustainable Development Group enters the third year of implementation of the management and accountability framework, and therefore the implementation has consolidated and matured, it is expected that we see more stabilization rather than improvement. In addition, while a management and accountability framework review is planned for 2024, the framework only covers aspects of how the current structure and coordination mechanism are managed and the associated reporting, but has no mandate to review the structure and coordination mechanism themselves. The structure and coordination mechanism were decided in General Assembly resolution 72/279 on the repositioning of the United Nations development system, and there are currently no processes planned by the General Assembly to change them. The Development Coordination Office therefore requests the Board to consider closing this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Further monitoring and evaluation are necessary to ensure the long-term sustainability and effectiveness of the accountability structure and coordination mechanism. Until a comprehensive review can confirm its full and sustained implementation, the Board considers the recommendation to be still under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that the accountability structure and coordination mechanism under the United Nations Sustainable Development Group is fully functional with regard to the implementation of the development reform initiatives.
history.administration_response: The Development Coordination Office is currently leading a process of reconfiguring the guidance and processes relating to the United nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework, in response to the system- wide evaluation of a new generation of United Nations country teams. As a result of these various interlinked processes, the drafting of a new management and accountability framework is currently on hold until later in 2026. Pending clarity on the way ahead with respect to reform of the development system, accountability structures and coordination mechanisms will be revised under the review of the management and accountability framework to ensure full alignment with the vision of the Secretary-General and guidance from Member States.
history.board_assessment: Given that the comprehensive review of the management and accountability framework is currently being undertaken, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
